[[Category:Set theory| 3]]
Let $A$, $B$ be [[set]]s.

<div class=center>
{| class="wikitable"
|-
! Observation
! Remark
! Notation
|-
| $\forall x \in A: x \in B$
| $A$ is a '''subset''' of $B$
| $A \subseteq B$
|-
| $(A \subseteq B) \land (A \neq B)$
| $A$ is a '''proper subset''' of $B$
| $A \subset B$
|}
</div>

<ref>{{#cite:Q2192}}</ref>

== Inferences ==

=== $A \not\subseteq B \iff \exists x \in A: x \notin B$ ===

=== $A \subseteq A$ ===

=== $\forall S: \emptyset \subseteq S$ ===
